trans-unit.source: Specifies the code of the intercompany partner that the transaction is related to if the entry was created from an intercompany transaction.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the related project.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the status of the entry: Open if it can still be applied or partially applied, Closed if it has been fully applied.
trans-unit.target: Specificerer postens status: Åben, hvis den stadig kan udlignes eller delvist udlignes, Lukket, hvis den er fuldt udlignet.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the posting date of the applied ledger entry. This is the date when the entry was originally recorded in the general ledger.
trans-unit.target: Specificerer bogføringsdatoen for den udlignede finanspost. Dette er den dato, hvor posten oprindeligt blev registreret i finansmodulet.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the quantity that was posted on the entry.

trans-unit.target: Angiver årsagskoden, en supplerende kildekode, der gør det muligt at spore posten.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the remaining amount of the entry that has not yet been applied. When the entry is fully applied, this value becomes zero.
trans-unit.target: Specificerer det resterende beløb for den post, der endnu ikke er udlignet. Når posten er fuldt udlignet, bliver denne værdi nul.

trans-unit.source: Specifies if the entry has been part of a reverse transaction (correction) made by the Reverse function.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om posten har været del af en omvendt transaktion (korrektion) foretaget med funktionen Omvend.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the correcting entry. If the field Specifies a number, the entry cannot be reversed again.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret på den korrigerende post. Hvis feltet angiver et nummer, kan posten ikke omvendes igen.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the original entry that was undone by the reverse transaction.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret på den oprindelige post, der blev annulleret ved den omvendte transaktion.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the source code that specifies where the entry was created.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the source document that the entry originates from.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret på det kildedokument, som posten stammer fra.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the amount of VAT that is included in the total amount.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the original total amount of the entry to apply in local currency. This is the initial amount before any applications.
trans-unit.target: Specificerer det originale samlede beløb for den post, der skal udlignes, i lokal valuta. Dette er det indledende beløb inden eventuelle udligninger.

trans-unit.source: Specifies a description of the entry to apply, providing details about the nature of the transaction.
trans-unit.target: Specificerer en beskrivelse af den post, der skal udlignes, med detaljer om transaktionens art.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the document number of the entry to apply. This is the reference number from the original transaction.
trans-unit.target: Specificerer dokumentnummeret for den post, der skal udlignes. Dette er referencenummeret fra den originale transaktion.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the general ledger account number of the entry that you want to apply to other entries. This is the source entry for the application process.
trans-unit.target: Specificerer finanskontonummeret for den post, som du ønsker at udligne mod andre poster. Dette er kildeposten for udligningsprocessen.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the posting date of the entry to apply. This is the date when the source entry was originally recorded in the general ledger.
trans-unit.target: Specificerer bogføringsdatoen for den post, der skal udlignes. Dette er den dato, hvor kildeposten oprindeligt blev registreret i finansmodulet.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the remaining amount of the entry that has not yet been applied to other entries. This represents the balance still available for application.
trans-unit.target: Specificerer det resterende beløb for den post, der endnu ikke er udlignet mod andre poster. Dette repræsenterer den saldo, der stadig er tilgængelig til udligning.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the remaining amount still to be applied after considering the amounts already selected in the lines below. When this value reaches zero, the application is balanced.
trans-unit.target: Specificerer det resterende beløb, der stadig skal udlignes efter de allerede valgte beløb i linjerne nedenfor. Når denne værdi er nul, er udligningen afbalanceret.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the unique identifier for this application. You can enter a specific ID to link this application with others, or leave it blank to have the system assign one automatically.
trans-unit.target: Specificerer den entydige identifikator for denne udligning. Du kan angive et bestemt ID for at knytte denne udligning til andre, eller lade feltet stå tomt og lade systemet tildele et automatisk.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the original total amount of the entry in local currency. Positive amounts represent debits, negative amounts represent credits.
trans-unit.target: Specificerer det originale samlede beløb for posten i lokal valuta. Positive beløb repræsenterer debiteringer, negative beløb repræsenterer krediteringer.

trans-unit.target: Specificerer dokumentnummeret for den finanspost, der kan udlignes. Dette er referencenummeret fra den originale transaktion.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the entry, as assigned from the specified number series when the entry was created.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the status of the entry: Open if it can still be applied or has a remaining balance, Closed if it has been fully applied and cannot be used for further applications.

trans-unit.source: Posts the application of the selected entries. The entries will be linked together and their remaining amounts will be updated accordingly. The remaining amount to apply should be zero or balanced before posting.
trans-unit.target: Bogfører udligningen af de valgte poster. Posterne knyttes sammen, og deres resterende beløb opdateres tilsvarende. Det resterende beløb til udligning skal være nul eller afbalanceret inden bogføring.

trans-unit.source: Executes the "Remove Entry to Apply" action
Clears the amount to apply for the selected entries, resetting them to zero so you can start over with a new selection.
trans-unit.target: Rydder beløbet til udligning for de valgte poster og nulstiller dem, så du kan starte forfra med et nyt valg.

trans-unit.source: Automatically sets the amount to apply for the selected entries, using as much of their remaining amount as possible without exceeding the remaining amount to apply.
trans-unit.target: Angiver automatisk beløbet til udligning for de valgte poster og bruger så meget af det resterende beløb som muligt uden at overskride det resterende beløb til udligning.

trans-unit.source: Executes the "Set Entry to Apply" action
Automatically suggests entries to apply based on the remaining amount. The system will propose matching entries from the same G/L account that balance the amount to apply.
trans-unit.target: Foreslår automatisk poster til udligning baseret på det resterende beløb. Systemet foreslår matchende poster fra den samme finanskonto, der afbalancerer beløbet til udligning.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the general ledger account number from the journal line that you want to apply to existing entries. This is the source account for the application.
trans-unit.target: Specificerer finanskontonummeret fra kladdelinjen, som du ønsker at udligne mod eksisterende poster. Dette er kildekontoen for udligningen.

trans-unit.target: Specificerer det samlede beløb fra kladdelinjen i lokal valuta. Dette er det beløb, der skal udlignes mod eksisterende poster.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the remaining amount that still needs to be applied. This is calculated as the journal line amount minus the applied amount. This value should be zero before posting.
trans-unit.target: Specificerer det resterende beløb, der stadig skal udlignes. Dette beregnes som kladdelinjesbeløbet minus det udlignede beløb. Denne værdi skal være nul inden bogføring.
